confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate. No live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked, and the city anchors were not sourced by web search. Restaurant and coffee anchors are menu-price estimates before sales tax and gratuity, moderately well grounded in general Los Angeles pricing. Accommodation anchors are less certain: July is peak season, rates vary with events and demand, and the hostel and 1-star hotel figures have the widest range. Accommodation anchors are estimated to include taxes and mandatory fees.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as an anchor. Estimates rely on general knowledge of Los Angeles prices, informed by general knowledge of other large US West Coast metros such as San Francisco and San Diego. Drink anchors were estimated from general knowledge and kept consistent with the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer; wine_glass about 1.9x beer).
